# Veteran Webworks

Veteran Webworks is a veteran-owned growth partner for local service businesses, focused on useful websites, automation, local visibility, AI front-office systems, and revenue protection.

## Services
- Web Design & Development: conversion-focused websites starting at $1,200+ one-time.
- Website Care: hosting, maintenance, backups, security, monitoring, and recovery from $97+/mo.
- Web Presence and Local Growth: profile accuracy, Google Business Profile care, posts, reviews, citations, and local optimization.
- Lead Growth: CRM, forms, booking, missed-call recovery, follow-up, reminders, reactivation, and reporting.
- AI Front Office: AI website assistant, AI receptionist, qualification, booking handoff, summaries, and human escalation.
- Revenue Protection: immediate lead recovery, estimate follow-up, reactivation, reputation support, and revenue tracking.

## Approach
Diagnose the customer journey, build the right digital layer, and improve it using real questions and behavior. Veteran Webworks uses plain-English communication and clear scope before production.
